test_test_robustness: test the python module to evaluate object detector robustness under image corruptions
run_test_robustness_benchmark: run the test_robustness tool to benchmark detector performance across gaussian noise, blur, weather, and digital corruptions
test_test_robustness_severities: test the python module with custom corruption severities from 0 to 5 for each corruption type
run_test_robustness_all_corruptions: run the test_robustness tool with all corruptions including noise, blur, weather, digital, and holdout categories
test_test_robustness_visualization: test the python module with --show and --show-dir options to visualize detector predictions on corrupted images
